title: My blanket had a hole in it. See picture.
text:
My blanket had a hole in it. See picture.. This Cotton Blanket Waffle Weave Thermal Blanket is beautiful. I got it as a throw on cool evenings. I was so disappointed to see a hole in it.

The blanket has a beautiful pattern. It has cleaning instructions on the tag. Would have made a great throw.

I will not be recommending this Cotton Blanket Waffle Weave Thermal Blanket to family and friends.
